dialog.title: claude-vault
dialog.heading: A credential is needed
dialog.subtitle: Enter the value for “{name}”. It is stored locally and is never shown to the AI agent.
dialog.footer: What you type here does not enter the conversation, the transcript, or any request sent to the model.
error.mismatch: The two values do not match.
error.no_prompt: No way to prompt: no graphical display and no terminal. Use --stdin, or run this in a terminal.
init.file_backend: No OS keyring was found, so secrets are kept in an encrypted file. Install the 'keyring' package to use the system credential store instead.
set.exists: “{name}” already exists. Pass --force to replace it.
get.blocked_agent: Refused: {agent} appears to be running this, and printing a value would put it in the transcript. Use 'vault run' instead.
get.needs_reveal: Refused: pass --reveal to print a secret value to the terminal.
run.missing: Not in the vault: {name}. Run 'vault need {name}' first.
run.no_command: Nothing to run. Usage: vault run NAME -- command args
env.blocked_agent: Refused: {agent} appears to be running this. Use --to FILE, or 'vault run'.
env.needs_flag: Refused: printing values to stdout needs --unsafe-stdout. Prefer --to FILE or 'vault run'.
env.gitignore: Warning: “{name}” is not in {path}. Add it before committing.
doctor.no_key: The index lists secrets but no key file was found; values may be unreadable.
doctor.key_perms: The key file permissions are {mode}; they should be 0o600.
doctor.no_hook: The Claude Code guard hook is not installed. Run 'vault install-claude'.
install.skill_exists: Skill already present at {path} (use --force to overwrite)
install.next: Next: restart Claude Code, then try 'vault need MY_API_KEY'.
